segments.t: In his dressing room after an emotional day of filming, Herve chats with makeup artist Vero. Impressed by his natural acting talent, Vero shares an exciting rumor she overheard from the film director. Let's listen to their conversation in French first.
Hervé, je suis très occupée aujourd'hui.
Tout est prêt dans ta loge.
Bien sûr Véro, pas de souci.
Tu étais encore extraordinaire sur le plateau!
Merci, c'était vraiment très intense.
Mais le tournage passe tellement vite.
Je veux encore profiter de ça.
Écoute, j'ai un grand secret.
Ta carrière d'acteur continue peut-être!
Quoi? Qu'est-ce que tu dis?
Valérie pense à toi maintenant.
Elle prépare son prochain grand film.
Elle veut te donner un vrai rôle!
C'est le plus beau jour!
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
Hervé, je suis très occupée aujourd'hui.
'Herve, I am very busy today.' Vero pops into the room while juggling several tasks on set.
Tout est prêt dans ta loge.
'Everything is ready in your dressing room.' She lets him know that the makeup remover is laid out.
Bien sûr Véro, pas de souci.
'Of course Vero, no problem.' Hervé is happy to remove his own makeup without fuss.
Tu étais encore extraordinaire sur le plateau!
'You were amazing again on the set!' Vero compliments his moving performance in front of the crew.
Merci, c'était vraiment très intense.
'Thank you, it was truly very intense.' Hervé is still emotional from acting out the dramatic scene.
Mais le tournage passe tellement vite.
'But the shoot goes by so fast.' Hervé wishes his time as an actor did not end so quickly.
Je veux encore profiter de ça.
'I still want to enjoy this.' He wants to savor every moment on set before returning to agency desk work.
Écoute, j'ai un grand secret.
'Listen, I have a big secret.' Vero lowers her voice to share confidential gossip from the crew.
Ta carrière d'acteur continue peut-être!
'Your acting career continues perhaps!' Vero hints that this small part might lead to more roles.
Quoi? Qu'est-ce que tu dis?
'What? What are you saying?' Hervé widens his eyes in disbelief and excitement.
Valérie pense à toi maintenant.
'Valerie is thinking of you now.' Vero reveals that the film director was praising Hervé earlier.
Elle prépare son prochain grand film.
'She is preparing her next big film.' The director is already planning her upcoming feature project.
Elle veut te donner un vrai rôle!
'She wants to give you a real role!' Vero adds that the director has a major part in mind for him.
C'est le plus beau jour!
'It is the most beautiful day!' Hervé beams with joy at the prospect of becoming a real movie star. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.

Thrilled by Vero's secret news, Herve gazes into the dressing room mirror like a true cinema star. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'busy' and 'ready'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
À demain!
